# #054 — Reporting Consumes Delivery Capacity
zg361cp.54 = {
	type = character_event
	theme = stewardship
	title = zg361cp.54.t
	desc = zg361cp.54.desc
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_i_owner
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_i_subject
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_i_cycle

		zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
		scope:zg361_cp_i_subject = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_i_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_i_subject

				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_i_case_serial

				EXPECTED_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_i_case

			}
		}
	}

					var:zg361_cp_portfolio_deferred = 0

				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_cp_report_policy has_variable = zg361_cp_report_policy_hours }
					var:zg361_cp_report_policy = 1
					var:zg361_cp_report_policy_hours = 1

				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_cp_report_policy has_variable = zg361_cp_report_policy_hours }
					var:zg361_cp_report_policy = 2
					var:zg361_cp_report_policy_hours = 4

# D+1 hidden queue edge: E closed -> I opens.
zg361cp.9001 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes
	trigger = {
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_e_owner
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_e_subject
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_e_cycle
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_e_case
		this = scope:zg361_cp_e_owner
		zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
		scope:zg361_cp_e_subject = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = zg361_case_e_owner
					has_variable = zg361_case_e_subject
					has_variable = zg361_case_e_cycle_serial
					has_variable = zg361_case_e_case_serial
					has_variable = zg361_case_e_state
					has_variable = zg361_case_e_active
				}
				var:zg361_case_e_owner = scope:zg361_cp_e_owner
				var:zg361_case_e_subject = scope:zg361_cp_e_subject
				var:zg361_case_e_cycle_serial = scope:zg361_cp_e_cycle
				var:zg361_case_e_case_serial = scope:zg361_cp_e_case
				var:zg361_case_e_state = 5
				var:zg361_case_e_active = 0
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
	}
	immediate = { scope:zg361_cp_e_subject = { zg361_cp_i_launch_effect = yes } }
}
